summary: Explains to_json escapes non-ASCII by default and ensure_ascii=False preserves Unicode, and from_yaml_all (2.7+) parses multi-document YAML into a generator.
questions: Why does to_json turn ü into \u00fc?
How do I keep Unicode characters in JSON output?
How do I parse a YAML file with multiple documents?

answer_card.title: Unicode in to_json and multi-document YAML
answer_card.answer_md:
`to_json` / `to_nice_json` escape to ASCII (`'München'` becomes `'M\u00fcnchen'`). Keep Unicode with:

```jinja
{{ 'München' | to_json(ensure_ascii=False) }}
```

For multi-document YAML (2.7+):

```yaml
loop: '{{ result.stdout | from_yaml_all | list }}'
```
